text: {"facts":[{"statement":"The task is to process up to 200,000 insert, conditional-delete, and one-based kth-smallest queries on a multiset of signed integers; duplicates count separately, and invalid k values produce NONE.","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"The first public example queries an empty multiset and expects NONE.","source_ids":["public1"]},{"statement":"The second public example expects NONE for a negative k; its operations also include deleting absent values.","source_ids":["public2"]}],"open_requirements":["No implementation language or specific deliverable format is stated."],"tentative_options":[{"id":"coordinate-compression-fenwick","method":"Read operations, compress values that occur in updates, and maintain frequencies with a Fenwick tree; use prefix counts to locate the kth element.","unverified_assumptions":["All operations can be read before processing so update values are known for compression."]},{"id":"order-statistics-tree","method":"Maintain a balanced tree keyed by value with duplicate counts and subtree sizes, supporting updates and kth-element selection.","unverified_assumptions":["An appropriate order-statistics tree can be implemented or is available in the chosen language."]},{"id":"dynamic-segment-tree","method":"Maintain frequencies in a segment tree over the stated integer value range and descend by subtree counts for kth selection.","unverified_assumptions":["A dynamic representation of the large value range fits the time and memory limits."]}],"possible_checks":["Check behavior on an empty multiset and on k less than 1 or greater than the current size.","Check duplicate insertions and deletion of one occurrence when duplicates remain.","Check deletion of an absent value and queries after insertions and deletions."]}
